title: Signal
description: One row of the `signals` table: the s1 score of a token at its latest evaluation. One row per (token, scorer_version); it is updated in place when new shillers appear. Rules: docs/signals.md. Source: backend/migrations/0005_signals.sql, backend/kairos/scoring.py.

created_at.description: When the signal first appeared (first evaluation).

updated_at.description: Last re-evaluation. The pipeline re-scores a token after new mentions or new shiller-wallet trades.

score.description: Rule-based score, the sum of `features.components` clamped to 0-100 and rounded to one decimal. Set by rules and statistics only; the LLM never changes it.

confidence.description: How much evidence stands behind the score, not how good the token is. `high`: the best shiller (among those with n_final >= 5) has n_final >= 30 and a second shiller has n_final >= 10. `medium`: n_final >= 10. Otherwise `low`. The bot delivers only `medium` and `high`.

n_shillers.description: Number of distinct shillers who mentioned the CA by evaluation time.

first_mention_at.description: Time of the first tweet with the contract address by any tracked shiller.

explanation.description: Legacy column for an LLM text. Current explanations are cached in `signal_explanations`, so this is normally null.

delivered_at.description: When the signal was first sent to any Telegram subscriber; null if never delivered.

features.description: Everything the score was computed from, as known at `evaluated_at` (no look-ahead). Stored as `signals.features` (jsonb). Floats are rounded to 4 decimals.

evaluated_at.description: The moment `t` the features describe. Only data known at `t` is used.

outcome_rule_version.description: Outcome rule set the history was read from (`token_outcomes.rule_version`), `v2` by default.

horizon.description: Outcome horizon used for shiller and creator history.

base.description: Base rates of the whole population at `t`.

success_rate.description: Share of `success` among final first-mention outcomes known at `t` (b).

rug_rate.description: Share of `rug` among the same outcomes (b_rug).

n_final.description: Number of final outcomes behind the two rates.

default_used.description: True when fewer than 100 final outcomes exist; then success_rate = 0.05 and rug_rate = 0.3 are used instead of measured values.

created_at.description: Token creation time; null when unknown (risk `unknown_creation`).

age_minutes.description: Minutes between the first mention and `evaluated_at`. This is the number shown as `minute N` in the Telegram card header.

entry_minute.description: Minutes from token creation to the first mention; null when creation time is unknown.

inside.description: Distinct shillers who mentioned the token before `t`, sorted by `lift` descending.

creator.description: Track record of the creator wallet: earlier tokens of the same wallet with a final outcome measured from creation, and created at least 24 h before `t`.

wallet.description: Creator wallet address (public), null if unknown.

past_final.description: Earlier tokens of this wallet with a final label.

past_rug.description: How many of them were labelled `rug`.

similar.description: Past tokens with a final outcome and a similar set of shillers (similarity >= 0.2). Shown for context only; weight 0 in s1.

jaccard.description: Jaccard index of the two shiller sets.

label.description: Final outcome label of the past token.

peak_multiple.description: Peak market cap / reference market cap of the past token.

components.description: Score parts in points. They sum to the (unclamped) score. See the table in docs/signals.md.

shillers.description: Up to +55 for the best shiller's lift over the base rate (only shillers with n_final >= 5).

breadth.description: Up to +20 for the number of distinct shillers; one shiller gives 0.

creator_clean.description: +10 if the creator has >= 3 final past tokens and no rugs.

entry.description: Entry-minute points. Weight 0 in s1, always 0.

similar.description: Similar-cases points. Weight 0 in s1, always 0.

rug_shillers.description: Up to -30 for shillers whose rug rate is above the base rate (only shillers with n_final >= 5).

creator_rug.description: -15 if the creator rugged before, -25 if twice or in at least half of the past tokens.

kol_holding.description: +4 per shiller who bought and still holds at `t`, at most +8. Added 21.10.2026; absent in older rows. 0 without wallet data.

kol_fast_dumpers.description: -6 per fast-dumper shiller, at least -12. Absent in older rows.

kol_sold_after_call.description: -10 once if any shiller sold within 30 minutes of their post. Absent in older rows.

best_shiller_n_final.description: n_final of the highest-lift shiller among those with n_final >= 5; 0 if none.

shillers_with_onchain.description: Shillers with wallet-trade data before `t`. Absent in rows created before 21.10.2026.

shillers_holding.description: Shillers holding the token at `t`. Absent in older rows.

risks.description: Risk codes shown next to the score.

shillerInside.description: One shiller who is already in. History counts are over this shiller's past tokens with a final first-mention outcome at `t` (each token once, current token excluded, attribution rule from docs/signals.md).

username.description: X handle without @ at the time of scoring.

first_mention_at.description: This shiller's first tweet with the CA.

minute.description: Minutes from token creation (or from the token's first mention if creation is unknown) to this shiller's first tweet.

n_final.description: Past tokens with a final label.

success_rate.description: success / n_final (raw, not shrunk); 0 when n_final is 0.

success_lb.description: Lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the success rate. Display only, no points.

lift.description: Shrunk success rate (success + 10b) / (n_final + 10), divided by the base rate b. A newcomer is about 1.

rug_lb.description: Lower bound of the 95% Wilson interval of the rug rate. Display only.

rug_lift.description: Shrunk rug rate divided by the base rug rate.

onchain.description: Wallet behaviour of this shiller at `t`. null when no wallet trades before `t` are known. Absent in rows created before 21.10.2026.

closed_positions.description: Positions (wallet + mint) of this shiller closed by a sell at or before `t`.

median_hold_s.description: Median seconds from first buy to first sell over closed positions.

fast_dump_share.description: Share of closed positions held for less than 60 seconds.

first_buy_at.description: First buy of this token before `t`.

first_sell_at.description: First sell of this token after that buy, at or before `t`.

holding.description: The shiller's last trade in this token at `t` was a buy.

bought_before_call.description: First buy happened before the first tweet. A flag only; no points.

sold_after_call.description: A sell in the 30 minutes after the first tweet.
